missing_before_plan_validation: approved and hash-recorded Windows installation media
candidate package hashes and fixed install command
fresh explicit approval for elevation and runtime execution
preconditions: VM is Off before baseline checkpoint or restore
clean-shell and controlled-package-baseline checkpoints are independently enumerated
stock wsl.exe command execution succeeds before package replacement
candidate package and recovery artifacts match recorded hashes
no host WSL files or configuration are modified
runtime_sequence: install only the fixed controlled package inside the VM
run the B6-T smoke contract through wsl.exe
record stdout, stderr, exit status, host service logs, and guest logs
shut WSL down inside the VM

acceptance.B4: primary and distro control channels remain alive without GNS or a system distro
acceptance.B5: wsl.exe dispatches a command and relays stdout, stderr, and exit status
acceptance.termination: normal and forced instance termination complete within recorded bounds
acceptance.recovery: checkpoint restore returns to the exact stock package and command execution passes

stop_conditions: any operation targets the physical host instead of the disposable VM
the candidate requests networking, DNS, DrvFs, WSLg, systemd, cgroups, or interop
a timeout occurs without independent proof that the process or VM stopped
